record_hint: Use the MCP tools firmware_record_decision, firmware_record_impression, firmware_record_vision_review, firmware_record_reconcile, firmware_record_read, firmware_record_insight and firmware_record_song_receipt (or `python -m firmware record <kind> --json <file>`). Impressions need 400+ characters, 3+ sentences, facets (observed, works, concerns, feelings, next_actions), claims quoting exact tokens from the artifacts, and an upstream entry for every sister impression you took in. Search sister impressions with firmware_records_search / firmware_records_digest.
